en.longDescription:
Radicale is a simple, open-source CalDAV/CardDAV server for calendars and contacts.

Connect clients to SERVICE_URL_RADICALE using basic auth with SERVICE_USER_RADICALE / SERVICE_PASSWORD_RADICALE. Collections persist under /data/collections.

de.longDescription:

Verbinde Clients mit SERVICE_URL_RADICALE per Basic Auth mit SERVICE_USER_RADICALE / SERVICE_PASSWORD_RADICALE. Sammlungen werden unter /data/collections gespeichert.
